Nox and Werkzeug remain blocked by malformed selectors in immutable dataset rows. Moto has a valid ECR-specific fail/pass but its full row is mixed-scope and includes invalid unrelated IoT selectors. Earthkit-data remains blocked by external fixture/provenance. Stage 3 technical adjudication pass remains Dishka only. Final accepted independent cases remain 0; no model load/inference/training. Recounting this ledger's 96 records gives 15 Stage 2-passed records, 42 not_started/not_started_conditional_gate records, and 5 blocked/held records (the remaining rows are static exclusions or other dispositions). Thus Stage 2 is not complete across the frozen cohort.

The broad NumPy selector test_columns_equal_numpy_arrays first asserts equality for non-empty np.array([j]) cells; the exact base columns_equal() short-circuits mixed object series to all False before reaching the empty-array block at the end.
